Context: 5. Emoluments and Average Emoluments

Average emoluments the last ten months of service.  
is the average of the emoluments drawn during - Rule 32.  
Service/ Retirement/ Death Gratuity is based on the emoluments drawn at the time of retirement / death while in service. However, Retirement / Death Gratuity will be based on the 'average emoluments' if the emoluments have been reduced during the last ten months of service otherwise than as penalty. - Rule 45 and Proviso to Rule 45 (6).
